Container.Name: pocket-commander
Container.Overview: Root-level file manager server for the Pocket Commander Android app (Krusader-style dual pane on your phone). Sign-in is via LLDAP; only members of the required LDAP group can use it. Put it behind Nginx Proxy Manager with HTTPS.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: Point Nginx Proxy Manager at this port (websockets not needed).

Config.Name: Files
Config.Description: What the app can browse. /mnt/user = all shares (like Krusader's /media). Map /mnt here instead to also see disks and pools, and set PC_TRASH_DEPTH to 2.

Config.Name: Host passwd (owner names)
Config.Description: Lets the app show Unraid user names instead of numeric ids.

Config.Name: Run as (PUID)
Config.Description: 0 = root: full access to every file and permission, like Krusader running as root. 99 = nobody: the app can only touch what Unraid's share user can (no chown, no root-only files).

Config.Name: LDAP URL
Config.Description: Your LLDAP LDAP endpoint (container name works on the same custom network, otherwise use the server IP: ldap://192.168.1.10:3890).

Config.Name: LDAP bind DN
Config.Description: A service user in the lldap_strict_readonly group.

Config.Name: Required LDAP group
Config.Description: Only members of this LLDAP group can sign in. Removing someone from it locks them out within 10 minutes.

Config.Name: Owner for new files
Config.Description: uid:gid applied to uploads, new folders and extracted files (99:100 = nobody:users, same as SMB). 'keep' leaves them owned by root.

Config.Name: Trash retention (days)
Config.Description: Deleted items go to a hidden .pc-trash folder in each share and are purged after this many days. 0 = keep forever.

Config.Name: Trash depth
Config.Description: 1 when /data is /mnt/user (trash per share). 2 when /data is /mnt.

Config.Name: Parallel jobs
Config.Description: How many copy/move/extract jobs run at once (extra ones queue).

Config.Name: Session lifetime (days)
Config.Description: App stays signed in this long without use.
